crossRefs.note: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Shamir
people.line: Issacharite judge who led Israel for 23 years

translations.web: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
translations.bsb: Tola judged Israel twenty-three years, and when he died, he was buried in Shamir.
translations.kjv: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
